_meta.note: Placeholders {n},{a},{b},{d},{h},{m},{k},{p},{t},{x} are filled at runtime with locale-formatted numbers, dates, SAR prices (p), clock (t) and insurer names (x). Brand and class names (Bupa Arabia, Tawuniya, MedGulf, Malath, VIP) and the unit code SAR stay Latin. Provider-app (ord22, ord30-33) ships ar+en; the other four languages are filled for the patient-visible preview and for shared keys.
